name: Signature I - Eucalyptus
description: Select this 1-person sauna if you want simplicity. With the push of a button, you’ll enjoy a deep cellular detox and support overall wellness in the sanctuary of your own personal home sauna. Surrounded in gentle far infrared heat, you can boost your immune system, improve circulation, and naturally detoxify your body.
